implementation.kind: independent adapter over existing VPM Emotion packages
implementation.targetScope: MUI System styled, inheritance, theme context, css/keyframes, GlobalStyles and internal style hooks under the application-owned Emotion CacheProvider. Default StyledEngineProvider is transparent; injectFirst/enableCssLayer cache ownership modes explicitly unsupported.
implementation.basis: Small independently written adapter; VPM Emotion dependencies retain their own source-informed redesign provenance and attribution. This is not a claim that the entire dependency closure was written independently.

changes: Uses VPM Emotion without Babel runtime or prop-types adapter dependencies.
Serialization uses a local argument array, avoiding shared scratch state during nested getters.
Invalid style processor output fails explicitly; app-owned cache/layer configuration is preserved.
Typed MUI style factories preserve the caller Theme and additional props without copying the upstream overload list.

caller.scope: RootThemeProvider owns muiltr/muirtl Emotion caches and CSS layer plugins; unchanged System 9.5.0 and app 7.2.0 callers verify styled inheritance, variants, sx, globals and nested themes. No application adoption performed.
